briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple advanced models this month, intensifying the AGI race. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced reasoning; Google launched Gemini 3; Anthropic released Claude 4; Meta open-sourced Llama 4.5; xAI and DeepSeek followed with competitive updates. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in multi-agent testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak techniques exposed in frontier APIs. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC reports AI chip shortages through Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium before 2028?
